content:
Apple has raised prices on most of its products in recent months, but more increases are expected next month, with products like the iPhone unlikely to escape unscathed.

The iPhone is expected to see a price hike, coinciding with the launch of the iPhone 18 series; the Apple Watch and AirPods may also be affected.

Earlier this year, Apple had already raised prices on a wide range of products.

The Mac, iPad, Apple TV, HomePod and Vision Pro all went up in price at the same time.

CEO Tim Cook had previously warned that a wave of price increases was on the way, but the sheer breadth of the hikes still comes as a surprise.

In the first round of price hikes, the only flagship products that escaped unscathed were:

  • iPhone
  • Apple Watch
  • AirPods

At the time, Apple hinted that more price increases would follow. Analysts also believe that the few products initially spared will face higher prices in the short term.

Products widely expected to see price hikes now include the iPhone, with the related news set to be announced at the iPhone 18 launch event in September.

There are rumours that the starting price of the iPhone 18 Pro will be between US$1,299 and US$1,399, compared with a starting price of US$1,099 for the iPhone 17 Pro.

Apple typically lowers the price of older iPhone models when new ones are launched. However, this year the prices of older models are expected to remain unchanged, or may even be raised slightly.

The Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 may also see price hikes, as the current AI-driven memory crisis will affect the supply of components for the watches.

Finally, the AirPods may also see a price increase. Compared with the iPhone and Apple Watch, the likelihood of a price hike is lower, because the AirPods should be less affected by rising memory and storage costs.

However, if Apple plans to raise prices across its entire product line, including the AirPods, then keep an eye on the September launch event.

What price adjustments do you expect from Apple? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
